subject: tu:game/ui/options
value: IMAGE-WIDE RELOC-SYMBOL DEFECT TABLE (2026-08-31). Method: rather than the narrower roster (real 0 / RELOCATION_ONLY only), the regnorm reloc-signature comparison was run over EVERY function of EVERY unit having both a target and an ours object -- same parse cost, strict superset. 257 units scanned (67 had no ours object), 405 `[reloc target differs]` rows across 191 functions. Rows were then ADDRESS-RESOLVED on both sides (see claim.law.parse-strips-the-lbl-address-so-signature-alone-cannot-clear-a-reloc-row.20260831.v1) and bucketed. RESULT: (c) SECTION ARTIFACT = 225 rows, every one `...bss.0` on our side, exactly claim.law.bss-array-reloc-names-its-section-not-the-object.20260831.v1 CASE 2 -- RECORDED, NOT CHASED, not source-reachable. (a) GHOST EXTERN = 5 found, ALL FIXED: aGridError (game/world/dynobjgrid, lbl_80112360, .rodata size 0xB == "GRID ERROR"+NUL), titlemenu_menu (game/ui/options, lbl_8011DEBC, .data 0xE8), hintmenu_menu (game/ui/options, lbl_8011F804, .data 0xE8 -- same size as titlemenu_menu, both OPTMENU, mutually corroborating), rune_idx_table (game/ui/options, lbl_8011F9F8, .data 0x148 -- NOTE size exceeds the declared s32[13]=0x34, so the split object is larger than the declared view; claiming the address is still correct but the object is not fully characterised), credit_text (game/ui/attract, lbl_80118188, .data 0x78 = 30 pointers). All five were declared `extern`, defined NOWHERE in the tree, and absent from symbols.txt; all three owning TUs are NonMatching, which is exactly why the latent `undefined:` never surfaced -- the linker used the extracted object. (b) DUPLICATE NAMING = 1, and it sat INSIDE A SINGLE TU: attract.c carried both `extern char lbl_80118188[]` (used twice, resolvable) and the ghost `extern char* credit_text[]` (used once) for the SAME address 0x80118188. (d) alias spellings already normalised by relocation_signature = skipped by construction. SEMANTIC BUGS FOUND UNDER THE SWEEP = 2, both wrong REL24 call targets, both fixed: game/world/gauntworld fn_8005DE50 called AudioPlayerPoison where retail calls AudioPlayerSeverePain (function was OPERAND_DIFF real 2 and is now regnorm-EXACT), and game/game/player damage_player did the same at its SECOND site (target calls Poison at +0x71c AND SeverePain at +0x7cc; our code called Poison at both). Origin identified: player.c declared `extern void AudioPlayerPoison` on TWO consecutive lines -- a copy-paste where the second should have been AudioPlayerSeverePain -- and the same wrong spelling propagated to gauntworld.c. REMAINDER, all triaged non-defect: 35 rows are pure naming gaps (both sides resolve to the SAME address, target simply carries an unclaimed lbl_ placeholder); 76 rows are our-side names unknown to symbols.txt that are file-local statics WE DEFINE (MSL bit_values/two_over_pi/npio2_hw, zlib border, boss HealthMeterFG/sBossStr, player got_it, mb_particle gNodeStack*, atree atreelist_save, mb_lights light_default_dir, SIBios Alarm) or MWCC `$NNN`-mangled function-local statics (GX tbl1$220/c2r$318/p2f$271, Pad recalibrated$390, SIBios cmdTypeAndStatus$76) -- a static we define is the OPPOSITE of a ghost, and most sit in 100%-matched TUs where byte-exactness proves them benign; the remaining ADDRESS-DIFFERS rows are POSITIONAL PAIRING ARTIFACTS in structurally divergent functions (regnorm pairs by position, so in a function at real 300+ with 80+ structural rows an unrelated instruction pair gets compared) -- e.g. combat get_cam_wpos real 487, sfx ProcessEffects real 2269, pb_diag pbDiagDrawInfo real 286; these are ordinary reconstruction debt, NOT symbol defects, and must not be 'fixed' from the pairing. DISCRIMINATOR that makes the table trustworthy: a reloc row is only DIAGNOSTIC in a function whose instruction stream already agrees (EXACT / RELOCATION_ONLY / REGISTER_ONLY, or real <= 6); 22 functions qualified, and exactly one of them (fn_8005DE50) carried a genuine defect.
